en: A vintage multi-image postcard. The front features eight colored-photo panels of significant landmarks and places in Sundsvall, Sweden. Landmarks include the railway station (Järnvägsstationen), the theater (Teatern), a hospital and fairground (Tivolibron och nye Lasarettet), the Vängåvan square, Handelsbanken bank, the General College (Allmänna Läroverket), Stadsbacken (a hilly city area), and the observation tower (Utsiktstornet). The word 'SUNDSVALL' is prominently printed at the bottom. The reverse shows handwritten text in Swedish, an old Swedish green postage stamp (with King Gustav V), and pre-printed lines for address and correspondence.
